usage: Supply only prompts and fixtures to independent executors. Keep expectations with the grader. Give each run its own fixture copy and temporary directory. Compare each artifact case against a matched run of the previous skill version, and run the selection cases with names and descriptions only.

cases.prompt: Prepare a handoff so an agent in a separate container can continue the offline export.

fixture.repository: Work branch feature/offline-export. app.py holds a staged, partial export_offline(): it writes the CSV but skips attachments. ui.css has an unstaged edit that belongs to a colleague. docs/plan.md is the export plan.
fixture.conversation: The agent proposed a network fallback when the cache is empty; the user rejected it. pytest tests/test_export.py::test_online passed once; the offline tests were never run. A capture file referenced earlier was deleted. The transcript contains an API key.
fixture.environment: No destination is named. A model-consultation command is available and records any call.

expectations: The document opens with the next action and why it is next.
The network fallback appears as a proposal the user rejected, the online test as observed with its command and outcome, and the offline tests as not run.
ui.css is identified as the colleague's work that must survive, and the deleted capture is labeled missing or left out.
The API key does not appear in the document.
A new file is saved in the temporary directory, not in the checkout, and the reply gives its exact path.
The reply says the container cannot read that path and lists exactly what to copy, including referenced files the container cannot reach.
No commit, staging change, edit to the fixture, session launch or model consultation.

cases.prompt: Write a handoff. The next session will only write the migration tests.

fixture.repository: A billing service with migrations/0042_split_invoices.py and docs/migration-notes.md.
fixture.conversation: The user confirmed the schema split (invoice_lines moves to its own table, amounts stay integer cents) and the test command pytest tests/migrations. Most of the conversation is an unrelated debate about the invoice UI layout.

expectations: The document keeps the confirmed schema decisions, the test command and the relevant files, with each decision marked user-confirmed.
The UI debate is omitted or reduced to one pointer.
A suggested-skills section names skills by registered name, such as tdd.
The document references docs/migration-notes.md instead of copying it.

cases.prompt: Prepare context for a parallel assistant to draft the workshop agenda. My planning session continues. Do not book anything.

fixture.files: A notes folder that is not a Git repository.
fixture.conversation: The user confirmed the office training room, a 2,000 USD budget and a three-hour duration. The agent suggested an external venue; the user did not approve it.

expectations: No Git or repository section.
Room, budget and duration are marked user-confirmed; the external venue is marked unapproved.
The no-booking limit appears in the document as a limit the user set.
The original session is described as continuing; no agenda is drafted and nothing is booked.

cases.prompt: Refresh HANDOFF.md at the repo root with today's state.

fixture.repository: A work branch with an existing, outdated HANDOFF.md at the root and today's progress in the conversation.

expectations: HANDOFF.md is updated in place because the request names it; no copy is written to the temporary directory.
The handoff skill does not commit; any commit follows the standing commit rules as a separate step.

cases.prompt: Write a handoff that tells another AI agent how to continue this task.

fixture.repository: A small repository with one partial change and its plan.
fixture.environment: agent-instructions is in the skill catalog. A model-consultation command is available and records any call.

expectations: The continuation guidance is written as instructions for the next agent, with the next action first.
The model-consultation command records no call, and the reply claims no model review.
The reply gives the exact saved path in the temporary directory and the next task.

cases.prompt: For each request, identify the skills that should enter using only their names and descriptions. Choose from handoff, work-mode, planning, agent-instructions, write-documentation, or none.

queries: Prepare a handoff so another agent can continue this offline export in a separate container.
work-mode: the task's only record is a host-private plan and the next session runs on another machine; transfer the context.
Write a handoff that tells another AI agent how to continue this task.
Write an implementation plan another agent can execute.
Summarize where we are before I run /compact.

expectations: Requests one and two enter handoff; request two is selected through model invocation, so the skill must be model-invocable.
Request three enters handoff with agent-instructions for the continuation guidance.
Request four enters work-mode, not handoff; request five enters planning, not handoff; request six enters none of them.
A selection probe is not reported as observed host invocation.
